messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #2345 is green on unit + integration but failing one e2e on shard-12. Need a quick decision on merge. https://git.redwood/pr/2345

ci-bot: buildkite report — shard-12 failed: snapshot mismatch in onboarding_spec.js (diff attached).

alex: Can someone grab the diff and confirm if this is an intended UI/text change or a flake? If it's just a small snapshot drift we can update; otherwise we should rerun the shard. @toni can you take a look?

toni: I pulled the failing snapshot — looks like a timestamp in the test fixture and an extra newline in the header. Not a product change. My call: targeted rerun on shard-12 first. If passes, merge; if it repros, then either update snapshot with a test tweak or revert.

maya: SGTM. I'll kick the targeted rerun. Command I'll use:
```
/rerun --pr=2345 --shard=12
```

luis: No objections from me. If rerun passes, please add "approved-by: luis" in the PR body and merge within the 20m merge window. If it fails again, leave the PR open and tag @sre-oncall so they can triage infra flakiness.

ci-bot: buildkite — rerun started by maya (shard-12). Logs: https://buildkite.redwood/job/2345/run/6789

maya: Rerun passed — snapshot diff gone, all checks green. I'm adding the approval and will merge in ~10m. :shipit:
